title: verifactu.records.create
description: Crea un registro VeriFactu encadenado (alta/anulacion) a partir de una factura. La lógica (hash chain, secuencia atómica, QR, encolado) vive en WASM — ver WASM-TODO.md.

tax_breakdown.description: Real per-rate breakdown, as the invoice module writes it: a JSON array of {tax, regime, class, rate, base, quota} in cents. It is what lets a bar ticket (drink at 21 %, tapa at 10 %) declare its TWO rates instead of one invented average. Empty means there is none, and the record is then judged by its own tax_rate.

line_count.description: How many invoice lines the tax_breakdown above aggregates. It is what makes an aggregated quota judgeable: the invoice module rounds the quota per line and adds up, so the admissible deviation from base x rate grows with the number of lines (4 lines of 0,50 EUR at 21 % aggregate to base 200 / quota 44, where the rate justifies 42). The automatic path counts them itself; through this door the caller is the one who knows. Omit it when you do not: the record is then judged as a one-line invoice, which is the safe side. It is a hint, not a field of the record - it reaches no column and no AEAT envelope, and it can never loosen the check past what the row constraint would accept anyway.

recipient_nif.description: Customer tax id for the Destinatarios block. Required by the AEAT for F1/F3/R1-R4 (it rejects them with error 1189 otherwise); empty for simplified tickets (F2).

recipient_country.description: Customer's country, ISO 3166 alpha-2. With it a foreign customer is declared as IDOtro instead of a Spanish NIF. Empty when unknown: the prefix of recipient_nif decides.

recipient_id_type.description: AEAT IDType of the customer's document when it is not a Spanish NIF: 02 NIF-IVA, 03 passport, 04 id in the country of residence, 05 residence certificate, 06 other document, 07 not registered. Empty: 02 inside the EU, 04 elsewhere.

substitutes_number.description: Number+series of the simplified invoice (F2) this F3 replaces — the FacturasSustituidas block (ADR-0140). Empty for anything that is not a substitution.
